title: D01 housekeeping and laundry programme and asset roles
conclusion: All four roles are useful and distinct as a bounded D01_laundry2 workplace kit. The linen carrier needs a specifically textile-focused carrying/transfer purpose to avoid duplicating the existing towel-return receiver or dining trolley. This audit approves no room layout, machinery operation or chore loop.

boundaries: No inferred active heat, airflow, humidity target or biological/hygiene result

candidate_asset_roles.name: Sorting and folding workbench
candidate_asset_roles.purpose: Give staff a supported flat surface for identifying, separating, folding and staging textiles, with storage supporting those tasks.
design_readout: Legible used/awaiting-process and ready-to-store staging intent without mixing them by default

candidate_asset_roles.separation_from_existing: A staff textile work surface differs from both guest towel dispensing and the small mobile dining-service trays. It must not become a generic decorated counter.
boundaries: Any separation labels denote design purposes, not contamination control or proven hygiene
No prescribed compulsory sequence, worker count, cleaning method or workstation ownership
Keep actual knee/reach/body and service clearances unresolved until a host layout and bodies exist

candidate_asset_roles.name: Distinct wheeled linen carrier

candidate_asset_roles.purpose: A manoeuvrable staff carrier for staged linens, with load retention, credible hand contact, wheels and a parking/transfer purpose.
design_readout: Purpose-specific textile holding body and load-retaining edges

candidate_asset_roles.separation_from_existing: AST-AQU-008 is a guest-return fixed station with a removable rolling receiver; AST-HSP-006 is a two-tier dining trolley. Neither establishes this independent workplace linen-transfer role. AST-MED-004 is clinical supply/retrieval and remains a separate purpose.

reference_pixel_audit.label_or_original_name: Crew + Medical + Engineering + Logistics; sheet 4 of 6, ASW-GV-04; printed v1.0.3, 25.07.04
observations: The lower Deck 03 Logistics & Services panel visibly labels housekeeping/laundry, stores/supplies and maintenance alongside the longitudinal service route.
The legend differentiates service corridor, separated guest circulation, restricted access and vertical circulation.
The panel gives useful programme relationships and an institutional service identity, not laundry equipment dimensions or operating design.
authority_limits: Master GDD reference plate 2 explicitly remaps this plate logistics D03 to canonical D01, engineering D04 to D02 and crew D06 to D03; medical remains D05.
The plate faces forward to page-right, opposite the atlas main-plan orientation. Do not transfer coordinates.
Printed machinery/facility totals, old deck labels and legacy species examples are not current allocation or capacity authority.

observations: Actual pixels show broad pale panels, long metallic protective contact rails, a regularly tiled floor, a high exposed structural/service zone and paired longitudinal pipes.
Small practical wall fixtures and repeated service supports organize the long passage.
authority_limits: Use broad washable-looking panel language, protected edges and coherent service mounting; no real material hygiene certification.
Do not infer a safe passage width, ceiling height, species fit or photometric performance from the photo.

observations: Actual pixels show pale block-like walls, dark door frames, exposed overhead conduits and parallel service runs, suspended elongated fixtures, and an uncluttered hard floor.
Workmanlike repeatable brackets, service organization and readable door outlines matter more than decorative clutter.
authority_limits: Do not copy the narrow photographed passage width or invent measurements.
Practical cool light and exposed services are visual intent; actual game illumination and clearance need separate checks.

biological_and_gameplay_boundaries: No demographics, body dimensions, reach envelopes or species-to-job distribution are assigned.
Baelin special-cleaner need is canon; names, ingredients, dose, process and actual textile/equipment compatibility remain open. No generic appliance claims universal compatibility.
Mantelid molting is extremely gruesome; frequency, privacy, depiction and care method remain unresolved. Do not turn it into infection simulation or ordinary dust.
Munko four-arm contact and all six actual body/environment interactions require later asset/host verification. Legacy broad 0.65 m screens do not certify them.
Mindo sentience and rights are preserved. No charging ports, fuel, food, connectors or rest system is invented.
Historical staff work means bounded arrived station time and aggregate background care, not a specific custodian physically carrying every linen load.
No new real treatment instructions, plumbing, equipment quantity, autonomous chore scheduling, worker throughput, economy rule or compulsory player action.
next_design_gate: Use the four distinct roles for component contracts only. A later room/host placement must establish actual room envelope, apertures, support and service access before any installed-workplace or operational claim. This audit does not relocate a room or replace the player cart.
